skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit worn by Silence while operating in Trimounts.
A symbiosis of convenience and fashion, the pieces were personally selected by the famous film star Marianne Blake.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Silence decided to abandon her past self's weakness to achieve her goals.
She buries the gentle side of her deep within, and walks onto the stage, vowing to show everyone her views.

skins.name: Habitat
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Habitat. Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.
skins.usage: One of Silence the Paradigmatic's casual outfits.
skins.quote: All foresight needs a place to rest, and that habitat is where all living things stand.
